description: MOLISEDB.GIS.MO_BC17G_Linea_ferroviaria_dismessa is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agenzia per l'Italia Digitale. The feature class MOBC17GLineaferroviariadismissed represents the linear elements of the mass railway.The data were produced on IGM Cards 1:100,000 in 1962. The source of the data and the Regional Directorate for Cultural and Landscape Heritage of Molise. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "MOLISEDB.GIS.MO_BC17G_Line_railway_dismissed" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
